subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking from New York to London on December 15th, 2021. Your flight details are as follows: Flight Number: ABC123, Departure Time: 10:00 AM, Seat: 23A. Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure. For any changes or inquiries, feel free to contact us. We wish you a pleasant journey! Best regards, The Travel Agency
